description: This file provides platform-specific functions for directly invoking mmap() and munmap() system calls, avoiding local overrides. It includes architecture and OS-specific implementations for memory mapping, primarily targeting Linux and Android platforms.

methods.name: DirectMmap
methods.description: Performs memory mapping using platform-specific syscall or fallback to mmap().

methods.name: DirectMunmap
methods.description: Performs unmapping of memory region using platform-specific syscall or fallback to munmap().
